verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a synced 2FA app with a server, but the evidence shows no public API: every OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404. The only programmatic surface is the Ente CLI, documented solely for exporting, backing up and decrypting Auth codes, plus a single search deep link. Neither covers UI actions like adding, editing, sharing, trashing or organizing codes, so they are adjacent features, not API parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
